name: com.realmweaver.client
description: Streams RealmWeaver chunks and generated textures from the Python bridge into a Unity 6 scene: HTTP PNG + chunk JSON, WebSocket ready events (ADR-0003). Generation stays in Python.
_notes: optionalDependencies is documentation only: UPM package manifests accept SemVer dependencies, not git URLs, so add the NativeWebSocket git URL to the project's Packages/manifest.json (#upm-2 = 2.x, #upm = 1.x). While it is installed the asmdef defines REALMWEAVER_WS and RealmWeaverEvents uses WS /events; without it the client polls /chunk state.
